definitions.explanation: to feel lonely; to miss (someone); to show loneliness

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寂|さび}しがって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧がいない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{寂|さび}しがる。
examples.english: Children feel lonely when their parents aren't around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠|とお}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寂|さび}しがって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He misses his friend who moved far away.

notes:
{寂|さび}しがる is a godan verb formed from the adjective ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧ (lonely) + the suffix ⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寂|さび}しがる / X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寂|さび}しがる (X misses Y)

ASPECT (ている):
{寂|さび}しがって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes someone visibly showing loneliness or missing someone.

The ⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ suffix is used to describe observable emotional states, particularly in third person:
- ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧ (I'm lonely) → {寂|さび}しがる (to show loneliness - typically third person)

Note: Can also be spelled {淋|さび}し⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧.

Related ⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ verbs:
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ (to show embarrassment)
- {怖|こわ}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ (to show fear)
- {欲|ほ}し⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ (to show wanting)
